title: Published engine data (search extracts of manufacturer / NASA pages; grade per row)

engines.name: RS-25 (SSME, 109 %)
sources: NASA SLS RS-25 fact sheet (via extracts)
engines.grade: A for thrust/Isp/MR; expansion ratio 69 (current large-throat MCC) vs 77.5 (original) is configuration dependent

engines.name: F-1
engines.grade: A for thrust/Isp/eps; B for Pc (70 bar vs ~965 psi conflict)

engines.name: NASA SP-125 A-1 example engine
engines.source: Huzel DK, Huang DH. Design of Liquid Propellant Rocket Engines. NASA SP-125, 2nd ed. 1971 (NTRS 19710019929), sample calculation for the A-1 stage engine (values transcribed in rocketisp 0.1.13 examples/A-1_Huzel*.py and an OCR of the NTRS scan)

acceptance.gate: RS-25 only: ideal (CEA chamber gamma / molar mass at its Pc, MR, eps) vacuum Isp must exceed the published 452.3 s by 0..+6 % (ideal >= real; RS-25 delivers about 96 % of ideal)

notGated.F-1: gas-generator cycle (turbine exhaust dumped into the nozzle extension) and film cooling: delivered Isp about 10 % below an ideal prediction; Pc sources also conflict (70 bar vs ~965 psi)
notGated.SP-125 A-1: used for the identity C_F,amb = C_F,vac - eps p_a/p_c (1.768 - 14 x 14.696/1000 = 1.562) only; gamma of the book's calculation is not stated
